author: Stahly
description:
In this free tutorial, I show you step-by step-how to paint Raven Guard in a moody, grimdark way. Whether for the 30th or 40th Millennium, this colour scheme works for all models of the 19th Legion, whether infantry or large vehicles. And since effective techniques like oil washes and chipping do the heavy lifting, it is even faster than you might think.

The post Tutorial: How to paint grimdark Raven Guard Infiltrators appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Tutorial: How to paint grimdark Raven Guard Infiltrators
